payload.why: ADD-03:7.2 prints a deletion in VOL-II:1.4 (', together with a grid connection point at the site boundary') and moves the grid connection, and its cost, to the Project Company, but only 'Where this Section 7 has effect', that is, only if the Authority gives the notice in ADD-03:7.1 by 12 November 2026 (10 Working Days before the 26 November 2026 Proposal Due Date). Whether the notice will be given is not known, so applying the deletion now would state a scope that may never take effect, and recording no_effect would hide a printed change.
payload.what_is_unsupported: A conditional amendment: the op types have no condition or trigger, so replace_text (deleting ', together with a grid connection point at the site boundary') cannot be made to depend on a future Authority notice. Limbs (b) and (c) also add a scope and cost allocation (grid connection procured by the Project Company; grid connection works form part of the Estimated Project Cost) that would need an annotation or a row once the condition is met. A person must decide whether to carry it as a conditional scenario, then apply the deletion if and when the notice is given.
